result:
Full suite passes. I've applied the upstream fix (pallets/click PR #3482, "pager doesn't close std streams"):

- `src/click/_termui_impl.py`: added a `_SkipClose` wrapper that proxies all attributes to a borrowed stream but no-ops `close()` and preserves the wrapper through `.buffer`. `_nullpager` now yields `_SkipClose(stream)` instead of the raw stream, so `echo_via_pager`/`get_pager_file` no longer close a caller-owned stdout/stderr (e.g. under `CliRunner`) when no external pager program runs.
- `CHANGES.rst`: added the changelog entry.
- `tests/test_termui.py`: simplified `test_get_pager_file_nullpager_keeps_stringio_stream` to assert the stream stays open (`not stream.closed`) instead of just checking identity.
- `tests/test_testing.py`: added `test_with_echo_via_pager`, a regression test using `CliRunner`.

All 1563 tests pass when run against the local `src` package.
